title: GenIA VLM output v1
description: What the VLM (e.g. Qwen2.5-VL) must return per image. Scored against scheme C/D human labels; never used as ground truth.

person_id.description: Set-of-Mark id drawn on the image, or the order of the given person boxes

bbox.description: x, y, w, h in pixels (optional when ids are given)

on_scaffold.description: yes = both feet on a scaffold platform above ground; attached ladder counts
